commands.label: environment-preflight
argv:
id
uname -m
rustc -vV
perl -MJSON::PP -MTime::HiRes -e "print qq(perl-clock-json-ready\n)"
du -sk /cargo /target
df -Pk /target

commands.label: source-freshness
argv:
find "$1" -type f -exec touch {} +
find "$1" -type f | wc -l
chmod -R a-w "$1"

commands.label: retain-binary
argv:
test ! -e "$2"
mkdir -p /target/retained
cp -- "$1" "$2"
chmod a-w "$2"
sha256sum "$1" "$2"
file "$2"
